text:
CHECK BURST P4c-SE-idle — Run C-3 matrix cell IDLE × SE: cut ONE registered cycle from its Grok clip with the FROZEN cut tool, then measure it with FROZEN gates — REPORT ONLY (no verdicts; every band here is a proposal). task_id "P4c-SE-idle".

Inputs (read-only): the clip /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/xvideo/in/SE_idle.mp4 (v1; 768×1168, 24 fps, 145 frames, #00ff00 plate). Frozen tools under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/ — read the docstrings, run them, never modify them: oracle/video_cut.py (CLI), oracle/bands_from_exemplar.py (measure, score), oracle/bands_proposed.json, gates/g6_seam.py (evaluate, g6c), gates/g1_height.py, gates/head_pitch.py (evaluate), gates/coherence.py (evaluate(frames_dir, None)), gates/matte_quality.py (rim_luma_excess). `python3 - <<'PY'` glue that imports these modules (sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst')) is fine; no new tool files; PIL + numpy + scipy only; ffmpeg at /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg.

STEP 1 — cut (exactly this command, once): `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && python3 -B -m oracle.video_cut --clip /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/xvideo/in/SE_idle.mp4 --kind idle --direction SE --n 16 --fps-out 8 --out /Users/admin/astra-burst/runs/C-3/P4c-SE-idle/out/cut --edge-mode clamp --prompted-period-s 2.0`. If it reports no cycle / no detection or writes no frames, do NOT retry with other parameters and do NOT choose frames yourself: record that in checks.json and go to STEP 3 (first_second.png only).
STEP 2 — measure (report only) into out/checks.json = {"cell":"SE_idle","clip":"SE_idle.mp4","clip_version":"v1","flags":[],"cut":<the registration.json blocks: period, selection or detection (key poses + confidence), splice (incl. suspect_inside_selected), transform, wall_seconds>,"results":[result envelopes]}. Frames = out/cut/frames/idle/SE/idle_SE_NN.png; rest = out/cut/frames/rest/SE/rest_SE.png. Each item below is one or more envelopes; if a call raises, append an envelope with value null, passed null and notes = the exception text, and continue:
  a) values, diagnostic = bands_from_exemplar.measure(...) — score against oracle/bands_proposed.json row 'idle_relaxed_video' (proposed); every scored envelope must carry passed = null.
  b) g6_seam.evaluate(frames) (G6 literal / G6b).
  c) G1 size stability: g1_height.evaluate(frame_i, rest) for every frame → one envelope with value = the max fraction and the per-frame list in notes.
  d) head_pitch.evaluate(frames, rest, fps=8) — report.
  e) coherence.evaluate(frames_dir, None) — report.
  f) matte_quality.rim_luma_excess(frame) per frame → one envelope, value = mean.
  g) closure: alpha-weighted mean |RGB| between frame 0 and frame 15, and between frame 15 and the rest frame (two envelopes, unit rgb_mad).
STEP 3 — sheets for the separate transcriber: out/grid.png = the 16 registered frames in a grid of 4 columns, 256-px cells on #3a3f4a, each numbered 0…15 in its top-left corner; out/first_second.png = the clip's native frames at t = 0.0, 0.5 and 1.0 s (ffmpeg select, no matte) side by side, each scaled to 384 px tall, labelled t=0.0 / t=0.5 / t=1.0.
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used must be 0. BUDGET: the cut takes ~30 s; everything else is quick — deliver within 12 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "P4c-SE-idle"; images []; files: out/checks.json, out/grid.png, out/first_second.png, out/cut/registration.json, out/cut/series.json, every out/cut/frames/** PNG and the strip, each with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything not computed. Never PASS/FAIL.
